h1: Use Hanzo AI with Hugging Face

p: Access Hugging Face models and use the HF Inference API through the Hanzo AI API. Also use Hanzo AI models with HuggingFace Hub tooling.
API Key: Get yours at platform.hanzo.ai/api-keys · Fully OpenAI-compatible · every model on the gateway available
License: Apache-2.0 · View source on GitHub →
Hanzo AI is OpenAI-compatible, so existing Hugging Face code works with zero refactoring. We deeply appreciate the Hugging Face team for building and maintaining this open-source project.

code: pip install huggingface_hub from huggingface_hub import InferenceClient client = InferenceClient ( base_url= " https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 " , api_key= " your-hanzo-api-key " , ) output = client . chat . completions . create ( model= " meta-llama/llama-4-scout " , messages= [{ " role " : " user " , " content " : " Hello! " }], )

# Use hf for model downloads, Hanzo for inference hf download meta-llama/Llama- 4 -Scout-17B-16E-Instruct # Then serve via Hanzo API from openai import OpenAI client = OpenAI ( base_url= " https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 " , api_key= " your-hanzo-api-key " , )

import { InferenceClient } from " @huggingface/inference " ; const client = new InferenceClient ( " your-hanzo-api-key " ); const chatCompletion = await client. chatCompletion ({ model : " meta-llama/llama-4-scout " , messages : [{ role : " user " , content : " Hello! " }], provider : " hanzo " , endpointUrl : " https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 " , });

curl https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/chat/completions \ -H " Authorization: Bearer $ HANZO_API_KEY " \ -H " Content-Type: application/json " \ -d ' {"model":"meta-llama/llama-4-maverick","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]} '

p: Create a free account and get your API key. The Free plan includes free model requests and Kai decisions, no card.
